faq.title: A few good things to know.
faq.intro: Need something we have not covered? We would love to hear from you.

items.question: How does my tiramisu arrive?
items.answer: Every order is packed in a temperature-controlled, insulated box with chilled gel packs. It is made to stay cool and lovely on its journey to your door.

items.question: How much is delivery?
items.answer: Delivery is one flat fee on every order, and you will see it in your bag before you pay.

items.question: How long will it stay fresh?
items.answer: Keep your tiramisu refrigerated and enjoy it within three days of delivery. It is made fresh in small batches, with no preservatives.

items.question: Can I order for a special occasion?
items.answer: Absolutely. Add a note for our kitchen at checkout. For larger celebrations, write to us and we will help you plan.

items.question: What about allergens?
items.answer: Our traditional tiramisu contains milk, wheat, and eggs. Some recipes include nuts. Full ingredient and allergen information is included with each product before checkout.
